notes: The official DroidKaigi 2026 conference app (Play Store and App Store, conference held 1–3 September 2026). It is rebuilt from scratch every year by a large contributor group working to a design the conference's own designers produce, which is why a conference app earns a place beside the products here. :core:ui is the design-system module — KaigiChip, KaigiSegmentedButton, KaigiTextField, SketchCard, the mascot art — and holds 42 of the repository's 160 preview-bearing files, all in core/ui/src/commonMain and all importing androidx.compose.ui.tooling.preview.Preview. The module applies the project's own KMP + Compose convention plugins and has an Android target, so it renders on the Robolectric lane. Two things a reviewer should know: many previews take their colour scheme through @PreviewParameter(KaigiSchemeProvider::class), and the repository is retired after the conference — the 2027 app is a NEW repository, so this import follows main until it goes quiet and is then either pinned or re-pointed. Apache-2.0.
